name: Spicrawl
description: Scrape web pages to Markdown or JSON, with batch jobs and persistent login sessions.
notes: Hosted MCP server (Streamable HTTP) with tools for scraping, batch jobs, persistent sessions, request history, usage, and docs search. Every tool returns structured results. Authenticates with a Spicrawl API key sent as Authorization: Bearer <key> (recommended; the server also accepts it in an x-api-key header). There is no OAuth. Scrapes and batch jobs spend credits from your Spicrawl account, and the usage tools need a key with the read scope.
installHint: Create an API key at https://app.spicrawl.com and paste it here. It is sent as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

auth.credentialHelp: Create an API key in the [Spicrawl dashboard](https://app.spicrawl.com). Sent as Authorization: Bearer <key>.
